new_content.name: Athenaeum books
new_content.how_to_obtain: Found in stronghold library and woodland mansion chests.
new_content.notes: Regular written books with a title, author and full text, generated by a loot function.

mechanics.title: Editions
mechanics.description: Books can be first, second or third editions. Default chances are 5%, 20% and 50% (configurable).

vanilla_changes.change: Stronghold library and woodland mansion chests can contain these books.

getting_started: Explore strongholds and woodland mansions and check the chests for books.
editor_notes: 102 book definitions (Andersen, English, Grimm, Japanese fairy tales). No minecraft-namespace overrides appear in the jar facts, so the stronghold/mansion injection mechanism is not confirmed beyond the README; verify in-game. Exact edition-chance semantics not checked.
name: The Athenaeum
summary: Adds public-domain written books, driven by datapacks, to loot chests in stronghold libraries and woodland mansions. Around 100 titles (Andersen, Grimm, English and Japanese fairy tales) are included. The pack author's own mod.
